title: DonutPlus
description: Makes DonutSMP better styled tab/scoreboard/chat, custom menus, and a full in-game config editor. active on DonutSMP.
body:
# DonutSMP Plus

A client-side Fabric mod that makes **DonutSMP** look and feel better. Everything is optional and fully configurable in-game — open the editor with **Right Shift** (or via Mod Menu). The mod only does anything while you're connected to DonutSMP.

## Features

- **Custom /shop** — re-adds /shop to DonutSMP, powered by the auction house (/ah).

![/shop](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7d4b5b09f2f3bb65b6de1a6e2f534d760870e683.png)
- **Styled tab list & scoreboard** — brings back the old tab list and scoreboard.

![tab](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/44b90454c0fcd85f56cb2461764819e8462c97cb.png)
- **Chat & DM formatting** — restores the old chat and DM formatting.

![chat](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/83721cb27208680717fd0a1b91ee8ba040345b18_0.webp)
- **Death messages** — brings back DonutSMP's old death messages.
- **Custom menus** — brings back the old /leaderboard, settings and stats menus.

![homes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/db3f50519aeae64ae366c928aa1c45d2762a10f6.png)
- **Profiles** — switch between whole config setups live, or drop your own JSON into the folder.
- **In-game config editor** — change every menu, command, name, lore and colour without leaving the game.

![settings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/954ddd6abc96bf6471417a0fbd946d721c29b18f.png)

## Notes

- **Client-side only** — safe to use, nothing is required on the server.
- Built for **Minecraft 1.21.11** (Fabric). Requires **Fabric API**.
- Open the config with **Right Shift** or through **Mod Menu**.
